citations.narrative:
In the radiology room, APHIS Officials observed the following non-compliances:
On the ceiling right above the door when you come into the room, Officials observed a black and fuzzy substance which
looked like black mold. The ceiling had water marks on the concrete (beige colored) covering an area of approximately
2.5ft by 2ft. The ceiling and walls of areas used by dogs and cats must be impervious to moisture or be replaceable.
Furthermore, the presence of black mold is of health concern for dogs and cats.
On the floor next to the radiology machine an area of approximately 2.5 inches in diameter of the linoleum was peeled off
and exposing the concrete beneath it. The floor of areas that come in contact with dogs and cats must be impervious to
moisture to clean and sanitized properly.
The floors and walls of indoor housing facilities, and any other surfaces in contact with the animals, must be impervious to
moisture. The ceilings of indoor housing facilities must be impervious to moisture or be replaceable (e.g., a suspended
ceiling with replaceable panels).
To be corrected by December 1, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with Facility Representative.
Additional Inspectors:
Lemnique Wafer, Assistant Director n
